rules.nvidia_open_pascal_maxwell_volta: (nvidia-open on Pascal/Maxwell/Volta causes a kernel panic).
rules.without_games_will_not_see: — without it games will not see Vulkan.
rules.dkms_cannot_build_module_without: DKMS cannot build the module without {}. Rebuild DKMS after installing.
rules.dkms_module_not_built_kernel: DKMS module is not built for kernel {}
rules.dlss_rt_not_available_card: DLSS and RT are not available on this card
rules.dlss_hardware_ray_tracing_require: DLSS and hardware ray tracing require RTX (tensor/RT cores). GTX 10xx and 16xx do not have them — use FSR or XeSS in game settings, they work on any card.
models.dx12_pascal_goes_through_vkd3d: DX12 on Pascal goes through VKD3D-Proton and works only on driver 580.xx (590+ branches and nvidia-open do not support this architecture). Proton 9+ / Proton-GE are required.
descriptions.fermi_no_vulkan_proton_dxvk: Fermi: no Vulkan, Proton/DXVK will not work. Only OpenGL games and native Linux games are suitable.
models.fermi_opengl_4_5_only: Fermi: OpenGL 4.5 only, no Vulkan — DXVK/Proton do not work.
descriptions.gtx_10xx_if_game_does: GTX 10xx: if a game does not start on DX12, switch it to DX11 in settings or enable “Force DX11”. DLSS and RT are not available on Pascal (no RTX cores).
descriptions.kepler_dx12_impossible_dx9_: Kepler: DX12 is impossible. DX9–11 need the old DXVK ≤ 1.10.3 (Proton ≤ 6.x / Proton-GE 6.x).
models.maxwell_pascal_volta_gtx_750: Maxwell, Pascal, Volta — GTX 750 / 750 Ti, GTX 9xx, GTX 10xx (1050, 1060, 1070, 1080), Titan X / Xp / V, laptop 9xxM / 10xx. Also works on RTX, but without new features
descriptions.maxwell_dx12_limited_crashe: Maxwell: DX12 is limited; on crashes use “Force DX11”.
descriptions.rtx_enable_nvapi_dlss_dxr: RTX: enable NVAPI for DLSS; DXR (ray tracing) is a separate checkbox. On laptops with hybrid graphics always launch the game via PRIME (checkbox above).
models.turing_newer_geforce_rtx_20: Turing and newer — GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50, GTX 16xx (1650, 1660), Quadro RTX, laptop RTX
rules.vulkan_does_not_see_graphics: Vulkan does not see this graphics card
rules.vulkan_loader_does_not_know: The Vulkan loader does not know about the NVIDIA driver — neither DXVK (DX9–11) nor VKD3D-Proton (DX12) work.
rules.wayland_prime_correct_output_games: Wayland, PRIME and correct output in games are enabled.
commands.echo_echo_done_reboot_system: echo; echo 'Done. Reboot the system to load the new driver.'
rules.nvidia_utils_puts_libnvidia_ngx: nvidia-utils puts libnvidia-ngx.so and nvngx.dll into /usr/lib and /usr/lib/nvidia/wine. Without them DLSS is unavailable in Proton — reinstall nvidia-utils.
gpu_page.pg_gpu_sync_not_installed: pg-gpu-sync is not installed — the buttons below are unavailable
gpu_page.not_recommended_black_screen_ke:
{} is not recommended for {}. Black screen and kernel panic are possible.
Install anyway?
rules.incompatible_with_branches_mutuall: {} are incompatible with {}: the branches are mutually exclusive
gpu_page.add_packages_repository_put_the:
{}: {}.
Add the packages to the repository or put them into {}/.
run_dialog.authorization_was_rejected_pk: Authorization was rejected or pkexec is unavailable (polkit is required).
gpu_page.without_dkms_nvidia_open_packag: Without DKMS: nvidia-open package (linux / linux-lts kernels only)
rules.without_vulkan_games_say_dx12: Without Vulkan games say “DX12 is not supported” or crash at start. Common causes: the driver is not loaded, no nvidia_icd.json, the VK_ICD_FILENAMES variable hides the NVIDIA driver.
rules.without_32_bit_driver_libraries: Without it the 32-bit driver libraries cannot be installed — Steam and 32-bit games work worse. Uncomment [multilib] in /etc/pacman.conf.
gpu_page.there_several_nvidia_cards_syst: There are several NVIDIA cards in the system: pg-gpu-sync picks the driver by the first one.
rules.graphics_card_not_bound_any: The graphics card is not bound to any driver — games will fall back to software rendering.
panel.no_graphics_cards_found_install:
No graphics cards found.
Install the pciutils package (lspci) and press “Refresh”.
gpu_page.choose_driver_branch_card_green: Choose a driver branch for this card. Green dot — recommended, yellow — works but not optimal, red — not suitable.
run_dialog.running_system_will_ask_admin: Running… The system will ask for the administrator password.
rules.glx_vendor_library_name_nvidia: __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia is set globally — faster for games but drains the battery more.
run_dialog.done_if_driver_was_changed: Done. If the driver was changed, reboot the system.
rules.vkd3d_proton_needs_vulkan_1: VKD3D-Proton needs Vulkan 1.3: update the driver of your branch.
rules.wayland_hybrid_graphics_stable_out: Wayland, hybrid graphics and stable output need modeset=1 — pg-gpu-sync will set it.
models.arch_has_no_proprietary_drivers: Arch has no proprietary drivers for these cards; nouveau is used.
rules.generation_nouveau_standard_option: For this generation nouveau is the standard option.
models.there_no_proprietary_drivers_gene: There are no proprietary drivers for this generation — nouveau is used.
rules.no_lib32_packages_exist_driver: No lib32 packages exist for this driver branch.
models.driver_470_provides_only_vulkan: Driver 470 provides only Vulkan 1.2: DX12 is impossible, DX9–11 only with old DXVK (≤ 1.10.3).
rules.driver_was_updated_but_kernel: The driver was updated but the kernel module is old. Reboot — otherwise you will get “Driver/library version mismatch” and Vulkan/DX12 will not work.
rules.driver_installed_but_kernel_module: The driver is installed, but the kernel module is missing — after reboot the card will be left without a driver.
run_dialog.finished_with_code_details_lo: Finished with code {}. Details are in the log above.
gpu_page.run_game_card_hybrid_graphics: Run the game on this card (hybrid graphics / PRIME)
rules.games_must_run_nvidia_prime: Games must run on NVIDIA: prime-run %command%. If a game lands on integrated graphics, DX12 “disappears” and DLSS is unavailable — the most common cause of problems on RTX laptops.
descriptions.how_apply_steam_game_proper:
How to apply: Steam → game → Properties → Launch options → paste the line.
For Proton choose Proton 9+, Proton-GE or Proton Experimental.
rules.card_runs_nouveau_not_nvidia: The card runs on nouveau, not on the NVIDIA driver
rules.card_runs_nvidia_driver: The card runs on the NVIDIA driver{}.
models.any_card_as_fallback_geforce: Any card as a fallback; for GeForce 8xxx — GT 3xx (Tesla) and older it is the only option
rules.nvidia_modules_ready_load: nvidia modules are ready to load.
rules.kernel_module_user_libraries_same: Kernel module and user libraries are the same version.
run_dialog.could_not_start_pkexec_instal: Could not start pkexec. Install polkit.
rules.non_standard_driver_example_vfio: Non-standard driver (for example, vfio-pci for passthrough to a virtual machine).
rules.needed_prime_run_running_programs: Needed for prime-run (running programs on NVIDIA).
rules.needed_by_steam_wine_32: Needed by Steam, Wine and 32-bit games (including DX9/DX11 games).
rules.required_game_actually_runs_nvidia: Required: the game actually runs on NVIDIA (not on integrated graphics), Proton 9+ / Proton-GE / Experimental and the variables PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI=1 DXVK_ENABLE_NVAPI=1 — a ready line is on the “Games” tab.
models.open_nvidia_kernel_modules_with: Open NVIDIA kernel modules with GSP firmware — for Turing and newer. This is the only 590+ branch; DX12, DLSS and ray tracing work here.
rules.open_mesa_kernel_driver_everything: Open Mesa/kernel driver — everything is standard.
rules.under_nouveau_there_no_nvapi: Under nouveau there is no NVAPI and DLSS, and DX12 (VKD3D-Proton) works poorly or does not start. Your card needs {}.
models.last_driver_branch_580_xx: The last driver branch (580.xx) that still supports Maxwell / Pascal / Volta. nvidia-open and 590+ branches do not start on these cards (kernel panic) — that is why exactly this package is needed.
models.last_branch_supporting_fermi_open: The last branch supporting Fermi. OpenGL only, no Vulkan. Packages come from the pg-gpu-sync offline cache.
models.last_branch_supporting_kepler_vul: The last branch supporting Kepler. Vulkan 1.2, no DX12. Packages come from the pg-gpu-sync offline cache.
rules.driver_470_limit_dx12_unavailable: Driver 470 limit: DX12 unavailable, DX9–11 only with old DXVK ≤ 1.10.3.
gpu_page.force_dx11_proton_no_d3d12: Force DX11 — PROTON_NO_D3D12=1 (if DX12 does not start)
rules.whole_desktop_runs_nvidia: The whole desktop runs on NVIDIA
models.first_generation_maxwell_gtx_750: First-generation Maxwell (GTX 750 / 750 Ti, GM107/GM108) has a reduced DX12 level — some games will not start.
rules.install_vulkan_tools_then_vulkan: Install vulkan-tools — then a Vulkan check will appear here.
panel.install_pg_gpu_sync_package: Install the pg-gpu-sync package (sudo pacman -S pg-gpu-sync) and try again.
gpu_page.installation_runs_via_pkexec_as: Installation runs via pkexec (asks for a password). Reboot the system after changing the driver.
rules.drivers_card_does_not_support: Drivers that this card does not support are installed
rules.packages_another_driver_branch_ins: Packages of another driver branch are installed
rules.make_dlss_work_proton: To make DLSS work in Proton
rules.enough_dxvk_2_x_vkd3d: This is enough for DXVK 2.x and VKD3D-Proton (DX12).
commands.neither_repositories_nor_offlin: neither in the repositories nor in the offline cache
